records.subject: The first multi-worktree PowerShell inventory projected a foreach expression directly into a pipeline and hit the empty-pipe parser edge.
records.recovery: The rows were first materialized into a named collection and then projected read-only.

records.subject: The first Git-blob baton reader combined raw cat-file output with PowerShell string conversion and returned no attributable content.
records.recovery: A bounded git-show reader covered every character interval through the literal EOF while the independent raw-byte hash probe remained authoritative.

records.subject: The first TXT execution wrapper evaluated the domain script in its own Node global scope and collided with the wrapper fs binding before any domain result existed.
records.recovery: The absence of every result and session latch was verified, then a function-scoped wrapper executed the same exact TXT bytes once.
